description: Bulk form of upsert_attribute: creates/updates many attributes — across any number of entities — in ONE load/save (use this instead of calling upsert_attribute in a loop; each single call costs several server requests and counts against the per-minute cap). Same per-item semantics, applied in order (primaryKey propagates child FKs; a domain decides the data type); all-or-nothing; results returned in input order.

defaultValue.description: Raw SQL default, emitted verbatim — quote string literals yourself ("'N'").

source.description: Target ERD — exactly one of a local file ({file}) or a server ERD ({erdId})

name: upsert_attributes
